_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Mostly sunny, with a high near 59. Southwest wind 7 to 10 mph, with gusts into the 20s.
 
March 28th: Join Deer Valley and Blood Cancer United on March 28 for the eighth annual Shred For Red event, a family-friendly ski day supporting blood cancer patients and their families. Ski alongside Olympians and Paralympians, explore on-mountain activities, and celebrate at an après-ski reception at Snow Park Lodge. Participants who meet fundraising minimums receive a full-day Deer Valley lift ticket (valid March 28, 2026), Shred For Red bib, access to the scavenger hunt and downhill racecourse, and entry to the après-ski celebration.
